title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.25927v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent world models predict the outcomes of action sequences, but comparing candidate plans through recursive rollout remains expensive at test time. We introduce Fast-JEPA, a latent world model planning framework that advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of predictive search. Fast-JEPA reorganizes predictive computation to support effective action-sequence search at low planning cost. It constructs a goal-directed plan to guide search and directly predicts the outcomes of complete candidates for efficient comparison, avoiding recursive state rollout during refinement. Across PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, Fast-JEPA achieves 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT. Search-budget sweeps show that its competitive success and low latency extend across candidate counts and refinement depths. translated_title: Fast-JEPA：推进潜在世界模型的成功率-延迟前沿
translated_abstract: 潜在世界模型用于预测动作序列的结果，但在测试阶段通过递归展开来比较候选计划仍然代价高昂。我们提出了Fast-JEPA，这是一个潜在世界模型规划框架，推动了预测搜索的成功率-延迟帕累托前沿。Fast-JEPA重新组织预测计算方式，以在低规划成本下支持有效的动作序列搜索。它构建一个目标导向的计划来引导搜索，并直接预测完整候选序列的结果以实现高效比较，从而避免了细化过程中的递归状态展开。在PushT、Reacher、Cube和TwoRoom任务上，Fast-JEPA实现了96.50%的平均成功率，规划速度比INTACT快2.41倍。搜索预算扫描实验表明，其在不同候选数量和细化深度下均能保持有竞争力的成功率和低延迟。我们进一步引入了DynaGoal，一个用于评估世界模型规划在动态分布外场景下表现的基准。
tldr: Fast-JEPA通过构建目标导向计划引导搜索并直接预测完整候选动作序列的结果来避免递归状态展开，以比INTACT快2.41倍的规划速度和96.50%的平均成功率推动了潜在世界模型的成功率-延迟帕累托前沿。
en_tdlr: Fast-JEPA advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of latent world model planning by constructing goal-directed plans and directly predicting outcomes of complete candidate action sequences to avoid recursive state rollout, achieving 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT.
